name: BARO - Pending Activations
query: select a.name as `Assignment`, a.serial_no as `Serial No`, a.baro_imei as `IMEI`, a.baro_vehicle as `Vehicle`, a.customer as `Customer`, a.from_time as `Installed At`, a.baro_technician as `Installer`, a.baro_activation_status as `Activation` from `tabBaro Device Assignment` a where a.docstatus = 1 and a.baro_status = 'Active' and a.baro_activation_status = 'Not Verified' order by a.from_time asc

name: BARO - Assignment History
query: select a.name as `Assignment`, a.baro_vehicle as `Vehicle`, a.serial_no as `Serial No`, a.baro_imei as `IMEI`, a.customer as `Customer`, a.baro_sim_card as `SIM`, a.from_time as `From`, a.to_time as `To`, a.baro_status as `Status`, a.baro_technician as `Installer` from `tabBaro Device Assignment` a where a.docstatus = 1 order by a.baro_vehicle asc, a.from_time asc

name: BARO - Fleet Reconciliation
query: select e.name as `Exception`, e.baro_exception_type as `Type`, e.baro_platform as `Platform`, e.serial_no as `Serial No`, e.baro_vehicle as `Vehicle`, e.customer as `Customer`, e.baro_status as `Status`, e.baro_assigned_role as `Queue`, e.baro_impact_billable as `Billable`, e.baro_detected_at as `Detected`, e.baro_cleared_automatically as `Auto Cleared`, e.baro_details as `Details` from `tabBaro Reconciliation Exception` e where e.baro_status in ('Open', 'Acknowledged', 'In Progress') order by e.baro_impact_billable desc, e.baro_detected_at asc
